description: This file contains static helper functions for file input/output operations related to PDF documents, including creating temporary file names, saving documents, and displaying PDFs in viewer applications. It is primarily used for unit tests and sample code within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PdfFileUtility
classes.description: A static class providing utility functions for handling PDF file operations such as creating temp files, saving, and displaying PDFs.

methods.name: GetTempPdfFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary PDF filename with a specific pattern, without creating the file.

methods.name: GetTempPdfFullFileName
methods.description: Creates a temporary PDF file, returns its full path, and ensures the file exists.

methods.name: FindLatestPdfTempFile
methods.description: Finds the most recent temporary PDF file in a specified directory, optionally searching recursively.

methods.name: SaveDocument
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument to a temporary file and returns the filename.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument and opens it in a PDF viewer.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocumentIfDebugging
methods.description: Saves a PdfDocument and opens it in a viewer only if debugging is active.

methods.name: ShowDocument
methods.description: Opens a PDF file in the default viewer application, handling different OS environments.

methods.name: ShowDocumentIfDebugging
methods.description: Opens a PDF file in the viewer if the debugger is attached.
